name: Hor
overview: Mount Hor is the significant location where the LORD commanded Moses to bring Aaron and his son Eleazar, marking the end of Aaron's earthly journey as he was to die there and pass his priestly garments to Eleazar. This event, described in Numbers 20, highlights God's judgment on Aaron for the rebellion at Meribah, preventing him from entering the Promised Land, yet also demonstrates God's providential care in the orderly transfer of priestly authority. The congregation witnessed this solemn moment, underscoring the importance of obedience and divine appointment in the leadership of Israel.
